name: DAY
description: DAY extracts the day of the month from a date.
tldr: DAY returns the day number (1-31) from a date.

parameters.name: serial_number
parameters.description: The date from which to extract the day.

advancedExamples.title: Find day of week
advancedExamples.description: Determine which day of the week a date falls on
advancedExamples.explanation: WEEKDAY returns 1 for Sunday, 7 for Saturday.

howItWorks: DAY extracts the day of the month (1-31) from a date serial number.

howToSteps.name: Select output cell
howToSteps.text: Choose where the day should appear.

howToSteps.name: Press Enter
howToSteps.text: The result shows the day number (1-31).

limitations: DAY only returns the day of the month.
For day of week, use WEEKDAY.

commonErrors.fix: Ensure the argument is a valid date.

googleSheetsEquivalent.description: DAY works identically in Google Sheets.

faq.question: Does DAY return the day of the week?
faq.answer: No, DAY returns the day of the month. Use WEEKDAY for day of week.
